title: Beacon of Hope
description: Whenever you gain Block on your turn, other players gain half that much Block.
smart_description: Whenever you gain Block on your turn, other players gain half that much Block.
notes: Triggers whenever the owner gains Block on their turn. Distributes 50% of the gained Block amount to other alive player creatures on the same side (excluding the owner). Only triggers if the amount to distribute is at least 1 point, and prevents recursive triggering during a single block gain event via internal flag.
